strings.text: Two programs cover TK through grade 8 until 6:00 p.m. — a nationally recognized Extended Day for Lower School and the drop-in Clubhouse for Middle School.

strings.text: A drop-in destination for every Middle Schooler, every school day, with no sign-up. Students may **self-register and sign themselves in and out** for practices, games, music lessons and rehearsals — a meaningfully more autonomous model than Lower School. strings.t: Yon destinasyon san randevou pou chak elèv Middle School, chak jou lekòl, san enskripsyon. Elèv yo ka **enskri tèt yo epi siyen antre ak sòti poukont yo** pou pratik, match, leson mizik ak repetisyon — yon modèl ki gen siyifikativman plis otonomi pase Lower School. Nan Lower School, sal etid la fonksyone pou grad 3–5 sèlman, lendi–jedi, 3:15–4:00 p.m., epi li eksplisitman se etid endepandan san okenn èd akademik youn a youn.

strings.text: No staff-to-child ratio is published for either Extended Day or Clubhouse, and Clubhouse publishes no daily structure or homework-support commitment at all.

strings.text: A strong TK–8 story: a nationally recognized Lower School program with the most transparent pricing in this set, plus a dedicated Middle School drop-in model many peers don’t offer.
strings.t: Yon bèl istwa TK–8: yon pwogram Lower School ki rekonèt nasyonalman ak pri ki pi transparan nan gwoup sa a, plis yon modèl san randevou dedye pou Middle School ke anpil lekòl parèy pa ofri.

strings.text: The open questions are ratios, the Upper School gap, and the unpublished Activity Day fee — exactly what a visit answers.
strings.t: Kesyon ki rete yo se rapò yo, mank nan Upper School la, ak frè Jou Aktivite a ki pa pibliye — egzakteman sa yon vizit reponn.

strings.text: **Best-in-class price transparency** — a complete published 40-cell grade × tier × days matrix, so a family can compute its exact annual cost before applying.
strings.t: **Pi bon transparans pri nan gwoup la** — yon matris konplè 40 selil ki pibliye pa nivo × palye × jou, kidonk yon fanmi ka kalkile depans anyèl egzak li anvan li aplike.

strings.text: **Three tiers for the youngest students**, explicitly designed around sibling-pickup logistics. The 1:00 p.m. TK dismissal is a real burden and the school priced an answer to it.
strings.t: **Twa palye pou pi jèn elèv yo**, eksplisitman konsevwa otou lojistik pou vin chèche frè ak sè. Lè lekòl kase a 1:00 p.m. pou TK se yon vrè chay epi lekòl la mete yon pri sou yon repons pou li.

strings.text: **A real enrichment catalog with real prices** — 15 Fall 2026 classes at $200–$220 across 10 sessions, taught by named outside professionals and PDS faculty.
strings.t: **Yon vrè katalòg anrichisman ak vrè pri** — 15 klas Otòn 2026 a $200–$220 atravè 10 sesyon, ansenye pa pwofesyonèl deyò ki gen non ak pwofesè PDS.

strings.text: **A published, division-specific enrichment rhythm** with escorted transitions and a school-provided nut-free snack — unusually concrete operational detail.
strings.t: **Yon ritm anrichisman ki pibliye epi ki espesifik pa divizyon** ak tranzisyon akonpaye ak yon goute san nwa lekòl la bay — detay operasyonèl konkrè yon fason ki pa abityèl.

strings.text: **Serious health and safety infrastructure** — an RN on duty daily, Magnus records integration, full CPR/AED/First Aid training, a nut-free protocol and a locked medication log.
strings.t: **Enfrastrikti sante ak sekirite serye** — yon enfimyè anrejistre an sèvis chak jou, entegrasyon dosye Magnus, fòmasyon konplè CPR/DEA/Premye Swen, yon pwotokòl san nwa ak yon rejis medikaman ki fèmen ak kle.

strings.text: **Financial assistance may extend to Extended Day and Clubhouse**, written on the tuition page. Uncommon among peers.
strings.t: **Asistans finansye ka pwolonje rive nan Extended Day ak Clubhouse**, sa ekri sou paj frè eskolè a. Sa pa komen pami lekòl parèy yo.

strings.text: **Strong Activity Day coverage** — 7:45 a.m.–6:00 p.m. on teacher workdays and most holidays, opening at 7:00 a.m. on conference days.
strings.t: **Bon kouvèti pou Jou Aktivite** — 7:45 a.m.–6:00 p.m. nan jou travay pwofesè ak pifò jou konje, epi li louvri a 7:00 a.m. nan jou konferans.

strings.text: **Clubhouse is cheap and frictionless** — $100/year flat, unlimited drop-in, with self-sign-out to practices and rehearsals.
strings.t: **Clubhouse bon mache epi li fasil** — $100/ane fiks, san limit pou vin san randevou, ak siyen sòti poukont ou pou pratik ak repetisyon.

strings.text: **Upper School isn’t covered.** Grades 9–12 dismiss at 3:10 p.m. with no published program of any kind.
strings.t: **Upper School pa kouvri.** Grad 9–12 kase a 3:10 p.m. san okenn pwogram ki pibliye ditou.

strings.text: **No before-school care on regular days** at any division — even though Activity Days show the capability exists at 7:45 a.m., or 7:00 a.m. on conference days.
strings.t: **Pa gen gadri anvan lekòl nan jou regilye** nan okenn divizyon — malgre Jou Aktivite yo montre kapasite a egziste a 7:45 a.m., oswa 7:00 a.m. nan jou konferans.

strings.text: **No drop-in for Extended Day**, stated explicitly. Occasional-need families are pushed to the $30/hour adjustment rate, which the school says is not drop-in pricing.
strings.t: **Pa gen opsyon san randevou pou Extended Day**, sa deklare eksplisitman. Fanmi ki gen bezwen detanzantan pouse nan to ajisteman $30/èdtan an, ke lekòl la di se pa yon pri san randevou.

strings.text: **Enrichment is gated behind Extended Day enrolment**, so a single class always carries a monthly Extended Day charge with it.
strings.t: **Anrichisman mare dèyè enskripsyon nan Extended Day**, kidonk yon sèl klas toujou pote yon frè Extended Day mansyèl ak li.

strings.text: **The Activity Day fee is unpublished** — an unbudgetable cost on the days that most often break childcare.
strings.t: **Frè Jou Aktivite a pa pibliye** — yon depans ou pa ka bidjete nan jou ki pi souvan kraze gadri.

strings.text: **Study hall is thin** — grades 3–5 only, Monday–Thursday, 45 minutes, and explicitly independent study with no one-on-one help. Grades 1–2 get none.
strings.t: **Sal etid la mens** — grad 3–5 sèlman, lendi–jedi, 45 minit, epi eksplisitman etid endepandan san okenn èd youn a youn. Grad 1–2 pa jwenn anyen.

strings.text: **Cost stacks on already-high tuition** — grades 1–5 full-time is $470/month on top of $32,960; TK full-time is $750/month on top of $25,510.
strings.t: **Depans lan anpile sou frè eskolè ki deja wo** — grad 1–5 aplentan se $470/mwa sou tèt $32,960; TK aplentan se $750/mwa sou tèt $25,510.

strings.text: Enrichment is a catalog of names with no operational detail — **no day of week, no grade range and no fee** for any of the 27 classes. The page that once carried that grid now returns a 404 and appears to have moved behind the parent portal.
strings.t: Anrichisman se yon katalòg non san okenn detay operasyonèl — **pa gen jou nan semèn nan, pa gen ranje nivo ak pa gen frè** pou okenn nan 27 klas yo. Paj ki te pote griy sa a yon lè kounye a bay yon 404 epi li sanble li deplase dèyè pòtay paran an.

strings.text: No hour-by-hour daily schedule is published, and no staff-to-child ratio or group size is given — only that each classroom has a lead teacher and an assistant.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn orè chak jou èdtan pa èdtan ki pibliye, epi yo pa bay okenn rapò estaf-a-timoun ni gwosè gwoup — sèlman ke chak sal klas gen yon pwofesè prensipal ak yon asistan.

strings.text: **Talons** youth sports runs alongside for grades 3–6 — field hockey, basketball, baseball, lacrosse, co-ed soccer and cross country, 2–3 days a week between 3:00 and 5:15 p.m., at $200–$350 depending on sport. Only Fall sessions are published; winter and spring are not.
strings.t: **Talons** espò jèn fonksyone akote pou grad 3–6 — hockey sou gazon, baskètbòl, bezbòl, kwòs, foutbòl miks ak kous kwaze, 2–3 jou pa semèn ant 3:00 ak 5:15 p.m., a $200–$350 depann de espò a. Se sèlman sesyon Otòn yo ki pibliye; ivè ak prentan pa pibliye.

strings.text: An unusually well-housed and well-staffed Lower School program with honest, linear pricing — that stops completely at grade 5.
strings.t: Yon pwogram Lower School ki byen loje ak byen estafe yon fason ki pa abityèl ak pri onèt ak lineyè — ki kanpe konplètman nan grad 5.

strings.text: The TK/K cost cliff and the near-total fee opacity are the two things to press on, and Middle School families should ask what happens at 3:20 p.m.
strings.t: Falèz depans TK/K la ak opasite prèske total sou frè yo se de bagay pou peze sou yo, epi fanmi Middle School yo ta dwe mande kisa k ap pase a 3:20 p.m.

strings.text: **A dedicated after-school building**, not a repurposed cafeteria or gym — materially better for a child spending three-plus hours a day there.
strings.t: **Yon batiman aprè-lekòl dedye**, se pa yon kafeterya oswa jimnazyòm yo re-itilize — materyèlman pi bon pou yon timoun k ap pase plis pase twa èdtan pa jou la.

strings.text: **Two credentialed adults per room** — "a dedicated lead teacher and assistant teacher" is a stated, structural commitment.
strings.t: **De granmoun ak kalifikasyon pa sal** — “yon pwofesè prensipal dedye ak yon pwofesè asistan” se yon angajman estriktirèl ki deklare.

strings.text: **Honest linear pricing with real granularity** — three genuine pickup times and 1–5 day choice, so a family needing exactly two days to 4:30 pays for exactly that.
strings.t: **Pri onèt ak lineyè ak vrè granilarite** — twa vrè lè pou vin chèche timoun ak chwa 1–5 jou, kidonk yon fanmi ki bezwen egzakteman de jou jiska 4:30 peye egzakteman sa.

strings.text: **Grades 1–5 pricing is genuinely modest** for this tuition tier — $295 a semester for one day a week to 4:30, and $2,950 a year for five-day coverage to 4:30.
strings.t: **Pri grad 1–5 vrèman modès** pou nivo frè eskolè sa a — $295 pa semès pou yon jou pa semèn jiska 4:30, ak $2,950 pa ane pou kouvèti senk jou jiska 4:30.

strings.text: **Full-day coverage on teacher workdays and conference days**, 7:30 a.m.–4:45 p.m., with real field trips — solving the days that most often break childcare.
strings.t: **Kouvèti tout jounen nan jou travay pwofesè ak jou konferans**, 7:30 a.m.–4:45 p.m., ak vrè vwayaj — sa rezoud jou ki pi souvan kraze gadri.

strings.text: **A deep 27-class enrichment catalog** with credible outside vendors, spanning STEM, arts and eight-plus sports.
strings.t: **Yon katalòg anrichisman pwofon ak 27 klas** ak vandè deyò ki kredib, ki kouvri STEM, atizay ak plis pase uit espò.

strings.text: **Talons is a real athletic on-ramp**, explicitly designed as the feeder into Hawks varsity teams.
strings.t: **Talons se yon vrè ranp antre atletik**, eksplisitman konsevwa kòm sa k ap alimante ekip varsity Hawks yo.

strings.text: **Activity-bus integration** at 4:30, 5:30 and 6:00, so after-school participation doesn’t strictly require a car at pickup.
strings.t: **Entegrasyon bis aktivite** a 4:30, 5:30 ak 6:00, kidonk patisipasyon aprè-lekòl pa egzije yon machin estrikteman lè yo vin chèche timoun nan.

strings.text: **Coverage stops dead at grade 5.** There is no Middle or Upper School after-school care of any kind. Middle School is the most stranded: its library closes at dismissal, leaving athletics or nothing.
strings.t: **Kouvèti a kanpe nèt nan grad 5.** Pa gen okenn gadri aprè-lekòl Middle oswa Upper School ditou. Middle School se sa ki pi izole: bibliyotèk li a fèmen lè lekòl kase, sa ki kite atletism oswa anyen.

strings.text: **The TK/K cost cliff is severe** — $1,725 a semester just to bridge the 85 minutes to the grade 1 bell, and $9,300 a year for five-day coverage to 6:00 p.m.
strings.t: **Falèz depans TK/K la grav** — $1,725 pa semès sèlman pou konble 85 minit rive nan klòch grad 1 an, ak $9,300 pa ane pou kouvèti senk jou jiska 6:00 p.m.

strings.text: **No published daily schedule** for a program a child may spend three hours a day in.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn orè chak jou ki pibliye** pou yon pwogram yon timoun ka pase twa èdtan pa jou ladan l.

strings.text: **Enrichment publishes names only** — no days, no grade ranges, no fees, and the page that once held that grid now 404s.
strings.t: **Anrichisman pibliye sèlman non** — pa gen jou, pa gen ranje nivo, pa gen frè, epi paj ki te kenbe griy sa a yon lè kounye a bay 404.

strings.text: **No drop-in option is published.** The model appears to be pre-registered fixed days billed by semester, with no published way to change mid-semester.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn opsyon san randevou ki pibliye.** Modèl la sanble se jou fiks ki pre-enskri epi faktire pa semès, san okenn fason ki pibliye pou chanje nan mitan semès la.

strings.text: **Fee opacity across the board** — registration, late pickup, schedule changes, refunds and the non-school-day rate are all unpublished, even though the summer camp publishes every one of its equivalents.
strings.t: **Opasite sou frè yo nan tout domèn** — enskripsyon, vin chèche an reta, chanjman orè, ranbousman ak to pou jou ki pa jou lekòl yo tout pa pibliye, malgre kan ete a pibliye chak grenn ekivalan pa l.

strings.text: **Financial aid is not stated to apply**, and after-school is filed under "other optional costs" alongside transportation.
strings.t: **Yo pa di èd finansye aplike**, epi aprè-lekòl klase anba “lòt depans opsyonèl” ansanm ak transpò.

strings.text: **The site contradicts itself on dismissal times**, and one pricing row breaks the pattern every other row follows.
strings.t: **Sit la kontredi tèt li sou lè lekòl kase**, epi yon liy pri kase modèl chak lòt liy swiv la.

strings.text: What are our options for after-school supervision once our child reaches Middle School? Is there anything between the 3:20 dismissal and the 5:30 activity bus?
strings.t: Ki opsyon nou genyen pou sipèvizyon aprè-lekòl lè pitit nou rive nan Middle School? Èske gen anyen ant lè lekòl kase a 3:20 ak bis aktivite 5:30 la?

strings.text: Please confirm the actual Grades 1–5 dismissal time — 2:55, 3:05, or 3:10? Your Transportation and After-School pages disagree.
strings.t: Tanpri konfime vrè lè Grad 1–5 kase a — 2:55, 3:05, oswa 3:10? Paj Transportation ak Aprè-Lekòl nou yo pa dakò.

strings.text: Please confirm the TK/K 1:30–4:30 rates: is five days really $2,540 and four days $2,300? Those break the pattern of every other row.
strings.t: Tanpri konfime to TK/K 1:30–4:30 yo: èske senk jou se vrèman $2,540 ak kat jou $2,300? Sa yo kase modèl chak lòt liy nan.

strings.text: Rates rose sharply between 2024-25 and 2026-27: **+32% at one day a week, +52% at two, +48% at three, +37% at four and +35% at five**. Budget forward rather than off older figures.

strings.text: The **3:05 p.m. auto-billing rule is expensive**: miss the 2:40 carpool by 25 minutes and a $50 drop-in is charged. There is no grace tier between "on time" and a full drop-in day.
strings.t: **Règ faktirasyon otomatik 3:05 p.m. la chè**: rate kovwatiraj 2:40 la pa 25 minit epi yo chaje yon $50 san randevou. Pa gen okenn palye tolerans ant “alè” ak yon jounen san randevou konplè.

strings.text: The sibling discount is thin — 25% for the **third** student only, applied to the lowest of the three rates. Two-child families get nothing.
strings.t: Rabè frè ak sè a mens — 25% pou **twazyèm** elèv la sèlman, aplike sou pi ba nan twa to yo. Fanmi ak de timoun pa jwenn anyen.

strings.text: "Through organized activities and supervised free time, the Extended Day program is designed to enrich the intellectual, spiritual, social, and physical development of students." Middle School runs the same shape on a compressed clock — attendance and snack 3:00–3:30, activity 3:30–4:00, homework and reading 4:00–4:30, then free play to 5:00. **Snack is not provided in either program**: "Please send your student with a snack and water bottle." Pickup authorisation is explicit and enforced — "We will not release your child to anyone other than the parents or those authorized," with ID checks early in the year.
strings.t: “Atravè aktivite òganize ak tan lib ak sipèvizyon, pwogram Extended Day la konsevwa pou anrichi devlopman entelektyèl, espirityèl, sosyal, ak fizik elèv yo.” Middle School fè menm fòm nan sou yon revèy konprese — prezans ak goute 3:00–3:30, aktivite 3:30–4:00, devwa ak lekti 4:00–4:30, apre sa jwèt lib jiska 5:00. **Yo pa bay goute nan ni youn ni lòt pwogram**: “Tanpri voye elèv ou a ak yon goute ak yon boutèy dlo.” Otorizasyon pou vin chèche timoun nan eksplisit epi yo aplike l — “Nou p ap remèt pitit ou a bay pèsonn lòt pase paran yo oswa moun ki gen otorizasyon,” ak verifikasyon idantite nan kòmansman ane a.

strings.text: The after-school club catalog is **deliberately private**: descriptions and registration go out only through the parents’ weekly *Focus* email. The school names the clubs — art, coding, flag football, lacrosse, running, soccer and STEM in Lower School; mountain biking, wrestling, chess, baseball, cheer and esports in Middle School; plus Junior Knights basketball and intramural cheerleading — but publishes **no day, no grade range and no fee** for any of them.
strings.t: Katalòg klib aprè-lekòl la **espre prive**: deskripsyon ak enskripsyon soti sèlman atravè imèl *Focus* chak semèn pou paran yo. Lekòl la nonmen klib yo — atizay, kodaj, flag football, kwòs, kous, foutbòl ak STEM nan Lower School; bisiklèt mòn, lit, echèk, bezbòl, cheer ak esports nan Middle School; plis baskètbòl Junior Knights ak cheerleading entramiral — men li pa pibliye **okenn jou, okenn ranje nivo ak okenn frè** pou okenn nan yo.

strings.text: Clubs run in an "eight-week stretch of both semesters for an additional fee" — two sessions a year, priced separately from Extended Day. The amount of that fee is never stated.
strings.t: Klib yo fonksyone nan yon “peryòd uit semèn nan tou de semès pou yon frè adisyonèl” — de sesyon pa ane, ak pri apa de Extended Day. Yo pa janm di konbyen frè sa a ye.

strings.text: No staff-to-student ratio and no program capacity are published for either division, and both published schedules are hedged "subject to change as needed".
strings.t: Pa gen okenn rapò estaf-a-elèv ak okenn kapasite pwogram ki pibliye pou ni youn ni lòt divizyon, epi tou de orè ki pibliye yo gen rezèv “sijè a chanjman jan sa nesesè”.

strings.text: The most operationally transparent program here — a published schedule, a protected homework block, and a genuinely clever Bridge Care tier — wrapped around rates that have risen very fast.
strings.t: Pwogram ki pi transparan operasyonèlman isit la — yon orè ki pibliye, yon blòk devwa ki pwoteje, ak yon palye Bridge Care ki vrèman entelijan — vlope otou to ki monte byen vit.

strings.text: The two hard edges are the split 5:00/6:00 deadlines between divisions and a club catalog you cannot see until you are already a parent.
strings.t: De bò ki di yo se dat limit 5:00/6:00 ki separe ant divizyon yo ak yon katalòg klib ou pa ka wè jiskaske ou deja yon paran.

strings.text: **A published, structured daily rhythm** for both divisions, with a protected 45-minute homework and reading block. No other school in this set publishes its schedule at all.
strings.t: **Yon ritm chak jou ki pibliye epi ki estriktire** pou tou de divizyon, ak yon blòk devwa ak lekti 45 minit ki pwoteje. Pa gen okenn lòt lekòl nan gwoup sa a ki pibliye orè li ditou.

strings.text: **Bridge Care is a real cost innovation** — $125/month to bridge the JK-K 2:20 bell to the grades 1–4 bell, instead of forcing a family onto a full $325 plan.
strings.t: **Bridge Care se yon vrè inovasyon nan depans** — $125/mwa pou konble klòch JK-K 2:20 la rive nan klòch grad 1–4 la, olye ke fòse yon fanmi sou yon plan konplè $325.

strings.text: **Middle School is pay-as-you-go at $8/hour with automatic registration** — no commitment, no form, no minimum. For occasional users this is far friendlier than a monthly tier.
strings.t: **Middle School se peye-pandan-w-ap-ale a $8/èdtan ak enskripsyon otomatik** — pa gen angajman, pa gen fòm, pa gen minimòm. Pou moun ki sèvi detanzantan sa a pi zanmitay lwen pase yon palye mansyèl.

strings.text: **The MS program is cohort-differentiated** between grades 5–6 and 7–8 — a real developmental consideration, since 8th and 5th graders in one room is a common failure mode.
strings.t: **Pwogram MS la diferansye pa gwoup** ant grad 5–6 ak 7–8 — yon vrè konsiderasyon devlopmantal, paske elèv grad 8 ak grad 5 nan yon sèl sal se yon mòd echèk komen.

strings.text: **Coverage to 6:00 p.m. for JK–4** is among the later end times in this market, and it is a hard, clearly stated cutoff.
strings.t: **Kouvèti jiska 6:00 p.m. pou JK–4** se pami lè fen ki pi ta nan mache sa a, epi se yon limit di ki deklare klèman.

strings.text: **Explicit, enforced pickup authorisation** with ID checks early in the year.
strings.t: **Otorizasyon eksplisit ak aplike pou vin chèche timoun** ak verifikasyon idantite nan kòmansman ane a.

strings.text: **A deep summer bench** — roughly 100 distinct camps across six weeks, JK–12, including an Orton-Gillingham literacy intervention.
strings.t: **Yon gwo ekip ete** — apeprè 100 kan diferan atravè sis semèn, JK–12, ki enkli yon entèvansyon alfabetizasyon Orton-Gillingham.

strings.text: **Rates jumped 32–52% in two years**, with the steepest rises on the mid-week tiers. Do not budget off older figures.
strings.t: **To yo te sote 32–52% nan de ane**, ak pi gwo ogmantasyon yo sou palye mitan semèn yo. Pa bidjete sou baz chif ki pi ansyen.

strings.text: **The 3:05 p.m. auto-billing rule is punitive** — 25 minutes late off the 2:40 bell costs a $50 drop-in, with no grace tier.
strings.t: **Règ faktirasyon otomatik 3:05 p.m. la pinitif** — 25 minit an reta apre klòch 2:40 la koute yon $50 san randevou, san okenn palye tolerans.

strings.text: **Middle School ends at 5:00 p.m., a full hour before Lower School.** A family with a 3rd grader and a 6th grader manages two different hard deadlines, and the MS late fee starts at 5:01.
strings.t: **Middle School fini a 5:00 p.m., yon èdtan konplè anvan Lower School.** Yon fanmi ak yon elèv grad 3 ak yon elèv grad 6 jere de dat limit di diferan, epi frè reta MS la kòmanse a 5:01.

strings.text: **No Upper School after-school care at all** — grades 9–12 dismiss at 3:20 with athletics, arts, or nothing.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn gadri aprè-lekòl Upper School ditou** — grad 9–12 kase a 3:20 ak atletism, atizay, oswa anyen.

strings.text: **Snack is not provided** in either program, unlike most peers here.
strings.t: **Yo pa bay goute** nan ni youn ni lòt pwogram, kontrèman ak pifò lekòl parèy isit la.

strings.text: **The sibling discount is thin** — third child only, on the lowest rate. Two-child families get nothing.
strings.t: **Rabè frè ak sè a mens** — sèlman twazyèm timoun, sou to ki pi ba a. Fanmi ak de timoun pa jwenn anyen.

strings.text: **Club fees are invisible before enrolment.** You cannot price the 8-week club sessions without already receiving the parent Focus email.
strings.t: **Frè klib yo envizib anvan enskripsyon.** Ou pa ka kalkile pri sesyon klib 8 semèn yo san w pa deja resevwa imèl Focus paran an.

strings.text: **Half days cost an extra $25**, so the monthly figure is a floor rather than a ceiling — and no teacher-workday or holiday care is published at all.
strings.t: **Demi jounen koute yon $25 anplis**, kidonk chif mansyèl la se yon plafon anba olye ke yon plafon anwo — epi pa gen okenn gadri pou jou travay pwofesè oswa vakans ki pibliye ditou.

strings.text: Extended Day covers JK through grade 8 to 6:00 p.m., with five separate pickup tiers — the finest-grained coverage ladder of any school here.

strings.text: "Our Extended Day program provides a warm, structured environment for students from JK through grade 8. Whether attending daily or dropping in occasionally, students enjoy a mix of homework time, outdoor play, games, enrichment, and a healthy snack." The school’s own feature describes it as "a home away from home filled with connection, creativity, and exploration", and names real activities — collaborative art, board games, Lego building, and playground time with **Peaches, the school dog**. Upper School students, who have no Extended Day of their own, appear in the program as cross-grade helpers.
strings.t: “Pwogram Extended Day nou an bay yon anviwònman cho ak estriktire pou elèv soti JK rive nan grad 8. Kit yo vini chak jou oswa kit yo vin san randevou detanzantan, elèv yo jwi yon melanj tan pou devwa, jwe deyò, jwèt, anrichisman, ak yon goute ki bon pou sante.” Pwòp atik lekòl la dekri l kòm “yon kay lwen lakay ki plen koneksyon, kreyativite, ak eksplorasyon”, epi li nonmen vrè aktivite — atizay kolaboratif, jwèt sou tab, konstriksyon Lego, ak tan sou teren jwèt la ak **Peaches, chen lekòl la**. Elèv Upper School, ki pa gen pwòp Extended Day pa yo, parèt nan pwogram nan kòm asistan ant nivo.

strings.text: The enrichment catalog is invisible to prospective families. The school advertises "more than 25 after-school enrichment classes" — music, art, science, chess, karate, cheerleading, field hockey, baseball, volleyball, SAT/ACT prep, coding, drama, robotics — but the class list lives behind the UltraCamp portal, which returned **zero results** when checked. No public page gives names with days, grades and fees.
strings.t: Katalòg anrichisman an envizib pou fanmi ki enterese. Lekòl la fè piblisite pou “plis pase 25 klas anrichisman aprè-lekòl” — mizik, atizay, syans, echèk, karate, cheerleading, hockey sou gazon, bezbòl, volebòl, preparasyon SAT/ACT, kodaj, teyat, robotik — men lis klas la ap viv dèyè pòtay UltraCamp la, ki te bay **zewo rezilta** lè nou te tcheke l. Pa gen okenn paj piblik ki bay non ak jou, nivo ak frè.

strings.text: Published enrichment session prices are **$260 for a 7-week full session** (about $37/class) and **$225 for a 3-week mini** (about $75/class), across four cycles a year — Fall, Mini-Winter, Winter and Mini-Spring.
strings.t: Pri sesyon anrichisman ki pibliye yo se **$260 pou yon sesyon konplè 7 semèn** (anviwon $37/klas) ak **$225 pou yon mini 3 semèn** (anviwon $75/klas), atravè kat sik pa ane — Otòn, Mini-Ivè, Ivè ak Mini-Prentan.

strings.text: The school publishes two conflicting ratios: the enrichment hub states a **12:1 maximum**, while the per-grade table above runs from 10:1 up to **20:1**. Both come from the school.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye de rapò ki kontredi youn lòt: sant anrichisman an deklare yon **maksimòm 12:1**, pandan tab pa nivo ki anwo a kouri soti 10:1 rive **20:1**. Tou de soti nan men lekòl la.

strings.text: No hour-by-hour daily schedule is published, no Extended Day staff-to-child ratio is given, and Middle School is not described as a distinct program — grades 5–8 sit under the same JK–8 umbrella.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn orè chak jou èdtan pa èdtan ki pibliye, yo pa bay okenn rapò estaf-a-timoun pou Extended Day, epi yo pa dekri Middle School kòm yon pwogram apa — grad 5–8 chita anba menm parapli JK–8 la.

strings.text: The most flexible and most transparently priced after-school program in this set — and the one whose enrichment offering you cannot actually see before you enrol.
strings.t: Pwogram aprè-lekòl ki pi fleksib ak ki gen pri ki pi transparan nan gwoup sa a — epi sa ou pa ka wè ofrann anrichisman li vre anvan ou enskri.

strings.text: Coverage stops hard at grade 8, the cost curve is steep at the top, and Extended Day appears to sit outside financial aid.
strings.t: Kouvèti a kanpe nèt nan grad 8, koub depans lan rèd nan tèt la, epi Extended Day sanble chita deyò èd finansye.

strings.text: **The most granular pricing ladder here** — 13 rows across five pickup times and five day-counts. A JK family needing 2:00 p.m. coverage twice a week pays $115/month, not a flat care fee.
strings.t: **Nechèl pri ki pi granilè isit la** — 13 liy atravè senk lè pou vin chèche timoun ak senk kantite jou. Yon fanmi JK ki bezwen kouvèti 2:00 p.m. de fwa pa semèn peye $115/mwa, se pa yon frè gadri fiks.

strings.text: **A full rate card on the open web.** Contract, drop-in, late and change fees are all published — no "call for pricing".
strings.t: **Yon kat to konplè sou entènèt ouvè a.** Frè kontra, san randevou, reta ak chanjman tout pibliye — pa gen “rele pou pri”.

strings.text: **Built for working parents by design**, and the school says so: "more than 50 percent of our two-parent families are dual income".
strings.t: **Bati pou paran k ap travay espre**, epi lekòl la di sa: “plis pase 50 pousan nan fanmi nou yo ak de paran gen de revni”.

strings.text: **Enrichment starts at the dismissal bell** for every division, with published per-grade ratios — no dead gap between school and activity.
strings.t: **Anrichisman kòmanse nan klòch lekòl kase a** pou chak divizyon, ak rapò pa nivo ki pibliye — pa gen espas mouri ant lekòl ak aktivite.

strings.text: **Four enrichment cycles a year**, including a low-commitment 3-week mini at $225, so a child can sample without a season-long commitment.
strings.t: **Kat sik anrichisman pa ane**, ki enkli yon mini 3 semèn ak angajman ba a $225, kidonk yon timoun ka eseye san yon angajman pou tout yon sezon.

strings.text: **Drop-in is a real option**, not a token one — $19/hour with a modest one-time $40 fee.
strings.t: **San randevou se yon vrè opsyon**, se pa yon senbolik — $19/èdtan ak yon frè modès $40 yon sèl fwa.

strings.text: **An on-site aquatic centre** with private and semi-private instruction, open to the public.
strings.t: **Yon sant akwatik sou plas** ak enstriksyon prive ak semi-prive, louvri pou piblik la.

strings.text: **JK is genuinely well served** — the early 1:15 p.m. dismissal is backstopped by five pickup tiers and a developmentally sensible 30-minute class at 10:1.
strings.t: **JK vrèman byen sèvi** — lè li kase bonè a 1:15 p.m. gen senk palye pou vin chèche timoun kòm sipò ak yon klas 30 minit ki gen sans pou devlopman nan 10:1.

strings.text: **No Upper School coverage.** Extended Day stops at grade 8; grades 9–12 get an enrichment slot and nothing else.
strings.t: **Pa gen kouvèti Upper School.** Extended Day kanpe nan grad 8; grad 9–12 jwenn yon plaj anrichisman epi anyen lòt.

strings.text: **Cost compounds steeply** — JK at 6:00 p.m. five days a week is $900/month, roughly $8,100 a year on top of $24,515 tuition, about a third again over sticker.
strings.t: **Depans lan anpile rèd** — JK jiska 6:00 p.m. senk jou pa semèn se $900/mwa, apeprè $8,100 pa ane sou tèt $24,515 frè eskolè, anviwon yon tyè anplis sou pri afiche a.

strings.text: **Extended Day appears to sit outside financial aid.** It is billed as an incidental charge with no published aid policy, even though about 30% of students receive tuition assistance — and summer programs do have their own aid application.
strings.t: **Extended Day sanble chita deyò èd finansye.** Yo faktire l kòm yon frè segondè san okenn politik èd ki pibliye, menm si anviwon 30% elèv resevwa asistans frè eskolè — epi pwogram ete yo gen pwòp aplikasyon èd pa yo.

strings.text: **Contract rigidity** — one change per semester, $50 for any additional change, and no changes at all in August or December.
strings.t: **Rijidite kontra** — yon chanjman pa semès, $50 pou nenpòt chanjman anplis, epi pa gen okenn chanjman ditou nan out oswa desanm.

strings.text: **The 2026-27 registration deadline has already passed** (5 June 2026), so a family enrolling now may face drop-in rates or a waitlist.
strings.t: **Dat limit enskripsyon 2026-27 la deja pase** (5 jen 2026), kidonk yon fanmi k ap enskri kounye a ka fè fas ak to san randevou oswa yon lis datant.

strings.text: **No published daily schedule.** Components are listed but never sequenced, and there is no homework-help staffing model.
strings.t: **Pa gen orè chak jou ki pibliye.** Yo liste eleman yo men yo pa janm mete yo an sekans, epi pa gen modèl estaf pou èd devwa.

strings.text: **The enrichment catalog is invisible** to prospective families — behind a portal that currently shows nothing.
strings.t: **Katalòg anrichisman an envizib** pou fanmi ki enterese — dèyè yon pòtay ki kounye a pa montre anyen.

strings.text: **Three portals, three logins** — Extended Day on Veracross, enrichment and summer on UltraCamp, swim on Jackrabbit.
strings.t: **Twa pòtay, twa koneksyon** — Extended Day sou Veracross, anrichisman ak ete sou UltraCamp, natasyon sou Jackrabbit.

strings.text: What actually happens between 3:15 and 6:00 p.m., hour by hour? How much is homework support versus free play?
strings.t: Kisa k ap pase vre ant 3:15 ak 6:00 p.m., èdtan pa èdtan? Konbyen ladan l ki sipò devwa kont jwèt lib?

strings.text: Is homework help staffed by teachers, or is it supervision only?

strings.text: Are Middle School students programmed separately from Lower School? What does an 8th grader do at 5:00 p.m.?
strings.t: Èske elèv Middle School yo gen pwogram apa de Lower School? Kisa yon elèv grad 8 fè a 5:00 p.m.?

strings.text: Does financial aid ever apply to Extended Day? If not, what do aided families do for after-care?

strings.text: What happens on school holidays, snow days and breaks?
strings.t: Kisa k ap pase nan jou konje lekòl, jou nèj ak vakans?

strings.text: Is the Kindergarten 6:00 p.m. row ($208 / $489 / $615) correct, or a typo? Every other row is round-numbered.
strings.t: Èske liy Kindergarten 6:00 p.m. la ($208 / $489 / $615) kòrèk, oswa se yon erè tap? Chak lòt liy gen chif won.

strings.text: Is snack included in the monthly fee, and what are the allergy protocols?

strings.text: One uniform program covers JrK through grade 8 from 3:00 to 6:00 p.m. — no age-based cutoff, no split between Lower and Middle School, and a genuine drop-in option.
strings.t: Yon sèl pwogram inifòm kouvri JrK jiska grad 8 soti 3:00 rive 6:00 p.m. — pa gen limit ki baze sou laj, pa gen separasyon ant Lower ak Middle School, ak yon vrè opsyon san randevou.

strings.text: Upper School has nothing. Every division dismisses at 3:00, so the coverage question here is simply whether a child is in grade 8 or below.
strings.t: Upper School pa gen anyen. Chak divizyon kase a 3:00, kidonk kesyon kouvèti a isit la se senpleman si yon timoun nan grad 8 oswa anba.

strings.text: The price on the bar is the **full-time annual rate — 5 days a week**, and Cannon publishes a single annual figure rather than a monthly one. 1–4 days a week runs $1,018–$3,290, or skip the contract entirely at $11.50 an hour; open **The Cost Planner** below for the full ladder. These are 2025-26 rates — no 2026-27 card is published.
strings.t: Pri sou ba a se **to anyèl aplentan an — 5 jou pa semèn**, epi Cannon pibliye yon sèl chif anyèl olye ke yon chif mansyèl. 1–4 jou pa semèn kouri $1,018–$3,290, oswa sote kontra a nèt a $11.50 pa èdtan; louvri **The Cost Planner** anba a pou nechèl konplè a. strings.text: The most flexible program here for occasional users, with the deepest published enrichment catalog — wrapped in pricing that is technically public but practically invisible.
strings.t: Pwogram ki pi fleksib isit la pou moun ki sèvi detanzantan, ak katalòg anrichisman ki pi pwofon ki pibliye — vlope nan pri ki teknikman piblik men pratikman envizib.

strings.text: The rate card survives only on an orphaned backup page, the figures are a year old, and grades 9–12 get nothing.

strings.text: **Long, uniform coverage** — 3:00 to 6:00 p.m. every regular day across the whole JrK–8 span, with no age-based cutoff and no split Lower/Middle program.
strings.t: **Kouvèti long ak inifòm** — 3:00 rive 6:00 p.m. chak jou regilye atravè tout etandi JrK–8 la, san okenn limit ki baze sou laj ak san okenn pwogram Lower/Middle separe.

strings.text: **Early-dismissal days are covered**, 11:45 a.m.–4:00 p.m., which several peers here do not do at all.
strings.t: **Jou lekòl kase bonè kouvri**, 11:45 a.m.–4:00 p.m., sa plizyè lekòl parèy isit la pa fè ditou.

strings.text: **True drop-in at $11.50 an hour with no contract.** A family needing two afternoons a month pays around $100 a year rather than committing to $1,904 — the most forgiving occasional-use model in this set.
strings.t: **Vrè san randevou a $11.50 pa èdtan san kontra.** Yon fanmi ki bezwen de aprèmidi pa mwa peye anviwon $100 pa ane olye ke angaje l pou $1,904 — modèl pou itilizasyon detanzantan ki pi endiljan nan gwoup sa a.

strings.text: **A sharp price ladder** — five days costs only about 3.7× the one-day rate, so heavy users get a real discount rather than a linear bill.
strings.t: **Yon nechèl pri ki byen file** — senk jou koute sèlman anviwon 3.7× to yon jou a, kidonk moun ki sèvi anpil jwenn yon vrè rabè olye ke yon bòdwo lineyè.

strings.text: **The deepest published enrichment catalog of the six** — 22 distinct classes in a single session spanning robotics, ballet, chess, pottery, golf and photography, each with a named provider and a real fee.
strings.t: **Katalòg anrichisman ki pi pwofon nan sis yo ki pibliye** — 22 klas diferan nan yon sèl sesyon ki kouvri robotik, balè, echèk, poterie, gòlf ak fotografi, chak ak yon founisè ki gen non ak yon vrè frè.

strings.text: **Enrichment is modestly priced and transparent** — $18–$30 per class, mostly $144–$300 for a 10-week session, with full refunds for cancelled classes and a make-up week.
strings.t: **Anrichisman gen pri modès ak transparan** — $18–$30 pa klas, sitou $144–$300 pou yon sesyon 10 semèn, ak ranbousman konplè pou klas yo anile ak yon semèn pou ranplase.

strings.text: **An executive-function class for Middle School** ("Let’s Get Organized") — a genuinely unusual offering at this age.

strings.text: **No after-school coverage for grades 9–12 at all.** A family with an Upper Schooler and a Lower Schooler gets care for only one.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn kouvèti aprè-lekòl pou grad 9–12 ditou.** Yon fanmi ak yon elèv Upper School ak yon elèv Lower School jwenn gadri pou yon sèl.

strings.text: **The pricing is practically hidden.** The rate card exists only on an orphaned backup URL inside a collapsed accordion, while the live page, the tuition page and the official fee PDF all omit it. A family doing normal research will not find it.

strings.text: **The published rates are 2025-26**, so expect an increase for 2026-27 that is not yet knowable.

strings.text: **Enrichment and care are separate purchases.** A 3:00–4:00 Beyond the Bell class does not cover you to 6:00, so the costs stack.

strings.text: The most parent-friendly entry price in this set — free morning care, $20 drop-ins — with a session system that quietly triples for the youngest families.

strings.text: Coverage matches the 6:00 p.m. peer standard; the catalog opacity is the one real gap.

strings.text: **Free before-school care from 7:30 a.m., school-wide** — every peer here charges for morning care. The Wednesday 8:50 late start is absorbed free too.
strings.t: **Gadri gratis anvan lekòl apati 7:30 a.m., nan tout lekòl la** — chak kanmarad isit la fè peye pou gadri maten. Kòmansman ta 8:50 Mèkredi a absòbe gratis tou.

strings.text: **Genuine flexibility**: $20 drop-ins, day-count tiers from one to five days, and an annual table with the half-rate months already priced in.
strings.t: **Vrè fleksibilite**: san randevou $20, nivo dekont jou depi youn jiska senk jou, ak yon tab anyèl ak mwa a mwatye to yo deja nan pri a.

strings.text: **Coverage to 6:00 p.m. for JK–8** matches the best pickup time in this comparison.
strings.t: **Kouvèti jiska 6:00 p.m. pou JK–8** matche ak pi bon lè ranmasaj nan konparezon sa a.

strings.text: **The published pricing is complete and current-looking** — monthly and annual tables both, on a live page, with the August/December rule stated in plain words.
strings.t: **Pri ki pibliye a konplè epi li sanble aktyèl** — tab mansyèl ak anyèl tou de, sou yon paj ki an dirèk, ak règ Out/Desanm nan deklare an mo klè.

strings.text: **The session system compounds for JK/K**: a 1:30 dismissal means three stacked sessions to reach 6:00 — $744 a month at the monthly rate, against a single-session headline of $248 that is easy to misread as the full cost.
strings.t: **Sistèm sesyon an ogmante pou JK/K**: yon kase 1:30 vle di twa sesyon anpile pou rive 6:00 — $744 pa mwa a to mansyèl la, kont yon tit sesyon inik $248 ki fasil pou mal li kòm pri konplè a.

strings.text: **No aftercare for grades 9–12** — high schoolers dismiss at 3:15 into athletics or activities, not a supervised program.

strings.text: Students are "subdivided into age- and attendance-appropriate groups as determined by Extended Care staff" and "must be signed out… by a parent or other authorized persons as listed on the Extended Care Application." Notably candid, and unusual to see in writing: the school itself described the roughly **15:1** after-school ratio as "significantly higher than comparable Davidson Day classroom student-to-staff ratios," while noting it "complies with State of North Carolina standards." All of this is from the 2020 capture.
strings.t: Yo “divize elèv yo an gwoup ki apwopriye pou laj ak prezans jan estaf Extended Care detèmine l” epi yo “dwe siyen sòti… pa yon paran oswa lòt moun ki gen otorizasyon jan yo liste sou Aplikasyon Extended Care la.” Sa ki remakab epi ki pa abityèl pou wè alekri: lekòl la li menm te dekri rapò aprè-lekòl apeprè **15:1** la kòm “siyifikativman pi wo pase rapò elèv-a-estaf konparab nan sal klas Davidson Day yo,” pandan li te note li “konfòm ak nòm Eta North Carolina.” Tout sa a soti nan kaptè 2020 la.

strings.text: Every quotation above comes from an archived capture dated **May 2020**. The live site carries no program description at all, so none of it is confirmed for 2026-27 — including the 15:1 ratio.
strings.t: Chak sitasyon ki anwo a soti nan yon kaptè achive ki gen dat **me 2020**. Sit ki an dirèk la pa pote okenn deskripsyon pwogram ditou, kidonk anyen ladan l pa konfime pou 2026-27 — ki enkli rapò 15:1 la.

strings.text: No enrichment catalog is recoverable. The archived page said the school "contracts with both internal and external providers… Programs are offered daily between 2:45-6 p.m., and fees vary by program. Sample offerings include:" — and the sample offerings resolve to three photo blocks with **empty captions**. No class name, day, grade range or fee survives, so none is listed here.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn katalòg anrichisman ki ka rekipere. Paj achive a te di lekòl la “fè kontra ak founisè entèn ak ekstèn… Pwogram yo ofri chak jou ant 2:45-6 p.m., epi frè yo varye pa pwogram. Egzanp ofrann yo enkli:” — epi egzanp ofrann yo rezoud nan twa blòk foto ak **lejand vid**. Pa gen non klas, jou, ranje nivo oswa frè ki siviv, kidonk nou pa liste okenn isit la.

strings.text: The **Learning Enrichment Center** is the only adjacent program with a live page, but it is tutoring, occupational therapy and speech — scheduled "during the school day, often during a study hall period" precisely so students can still do after-school activities. It is not after-school care.
strings.t: **Learning Enrichment Center** la se sèl pwogram akote ki gen yon paj an dirèk, men se titora, terapi okipasyonèl ak lapawòl — pwograme “pandan jounen lekòl la, souvan pandan yon peryòd sal etid” presizeman pou elèv yo ka toujou fè aktivite aprè-lekòl. Se pa gadri aprè-lekòl.

strings.text: A program that almost certainly works fine — and that a prospective family has no way to evaluate, price, or even read about before enrolling.
strings.t: Yon pwogram ki prèske sètènman mache byen — epi ke yon fanmi ki enterese pa gen okenn fason pou evalye, mete pri sou li, oswa menm li sou li anvan li enskri.

strings.text: Extended care is explicitly excluded from financial aid, which makes the missing price tag a real decision problem rather than a documentation quibble.
strings.t: Gadri pwolonje eksplisitman eskli nan èd finansye, sa ki fè pri ki manke a yon vrè pwoblèm desizyon olye ke yon ti kritik sou dokimantasyon.

strings.text: **Coverage runs to 6:00 p.m.**, competitive with peers, and spans **Traditional Toddler through grade 8** — including a toddler tier most schools here do not cover at all.
strings.t: **Kouvèti a kouri jiska 6:00 p.m.**, konpetitif ak lekòl parèy, epi li kouvri **Traditional Toddler jiska grad 8** — ki enkli yon palye pou timoun piti pifò lekòl isit la pa kouvri ditou.

strings.text: **Before School Care was teacher-staffed at 7:1** — genuinely strong for before-care, and staffed by full-time Davidson Day teachers rather than outside hires, if it still holds.
strings.t: **Before School Care te gen pwofesè kòm estaf nan 7:1** — vrèman solid pou gadri anvan lekòl, epi ak pwofesè Davidson Day aplentan olye ke moun yo anboche deyò, si sa toujou vre.

strings.text: **The school is straightforwardly honest that aid does not reach extended care**, stating it plainly on the tuition page rather than burying it in a fee schedule.
strings.t: **Lekòl la onèt san detou ke èd la pa rive nan gadri pwolonje**, li deklare sa klèman sou paj frè eskolè a olye ke antere l nan yon barèm frè.

strings.text: **A long-running program with a real operating history** — the archived material describes an established operation with sign-out procedures and age-appropriate grouping.
strings.t: **Yon pwogram ki la depi lontan ak yon vrè istwa operasyon** — materyèl achive a dekri yon operasyon etabli ak pwosedi pou siyen sòti ak gwoupman ki apwopriye pou laj.

strings.text: **Total pricing opacity.** No registration fee, no daily or hourly rate, no late-pickup fee, no billing method — nothing, anywhere, including in the 2020 archive. This is long-standing policy, not a broken page.
strings.t: **Opasite total sou pri.** Pa gen frè enskripsyon, pa gen to pa jou oswa pa èdtan, pa gen frè pou vin chèche an reta, pa gen metòd faktirasyon — anyen, okenn kote, ki enkli nan achiv 2020 la. Sa a se yon politik ki la depi lontan, se pa yon paj ki kase.

strings.text: **The program pages have been deleted from the live site.** Both the Extended Care and After School Programs URLs return 404 and neither appears in the site map, so there is no current published description to read.
strings.t: **Yo efase paj pwogram yo sou sit ki an dirèk la.** Tou de URL Extended Care ak After School Programs bay 404 epi ni youn ni lòt pa parèt nan plan sit la, kidonk pa gen okenn deskripsyon aktyèl ki pibliye pou li.

strings.text: **Extended care is excluded from financial aid** — "Financial Aid does not cover extended care" — making it a pure out-of-pocket add-on on top of $22,590–$26,910 tuition. Maximum aid still requires families to pay $3,000 a year per student.
strings.t: **Gadri pwolonje eskli nan èd finansye** — “Èd Finansye pa kouvri gadri pwolonje” — sa ki fè l yon ajou pi lwen pase pòch ou sou tèt $22,590–$26,910 frè eskolè. Èd maksimòm egzije toujou pou fanmi peye $3,000 pa ane pa elèv.

strings.text: **The school itself flagged the ratio.** A roughly 15:1 after-school ratio was described in its own words as "significantly higher than comparable Davidson Day classroom student-to-staff ratios."
strings.t: **Lekòl la li menm te make rapò a.** Li te dekri yon rapò aprè-lekòl apeprè 15:1 nan pwòp mo pa l kòm “siyifikativman pi wo pase rapò elèv-a-estaf konparab nan sal klas Davidson Day yo.”

strings.text: **Sign-ups are not released until mid-July**, which is late for families arranging childcare around a work schedule.
strings.t: **Enskripsyon pa sòti jiska mitan jiyè**, sa ki an reta pou fanmi k ap ranje gadri otou yon orè travay.

strings.text: **No Upper School coverage**, and a 40-minute spread of staggered dismissals for families with children in more than one division.

strings.t: Pwogram Extended Day la kouvri depi K jiska klas 8 jiska 6:00 p.m., separe ant Young Cougars Club matènèl la ak After School care pou klas 1–8.

strings.text: Before-school care opens at 7:30 a.m. for CCS students, and a longer WEE-School sibling window runs to 9:00 a.m. The whole program is built on the school’s “Grow and Go” mission — “GROW to become followers of Christ and GO make Him known to the world.”

strings.text: A single K–8 program that covers the whole work day — 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. — with fully published, plainly priced rates and a genuinely structured kindergarten afternoon.
strings.t: Yon sèl pwogram K–8 ki kouvri tout jounen travay la — 7:30 a.m. rive 6:00 p.m. — ak tarif ki byen pibliye, ki gen pri klè, ansanm ak yon apremidi matènèl ki vrèman estriktire.

strings.text: The open questions are capacity (the year is already “full”), the missing enrichment list, and the unpublished registration fee and sibling discount — exactly what a visit answers.
strings.t: Kesyon ki rete louvri yo se kapasite (ane a deja “full”), lis anrichisman ki manke a, ak frè enskripsyon ak rabè frè/sè ki pa pibliye yo — egzakteman sa yon vizit reponn.

strings.text: **Whole-work-day coverage in one program** — before care from 7:30 a.m. and After School to 6:00 p.m., spanning kindergarten through grade 8 without a division gap.
strings.t: **Kouvèti tout jounen travay la nan yon sèl pwogram** — swen anvan lekòl depi 7:30 a.m. ak After School jiska 6:00 p.m., ki kouvri depi matènèl jiska klas 8 san yon twou ant divizyon yo.

strings.text: **Fully published, readable pricing** — every session has a 5-day, 3-day and drop-in rate in the handbook, so a family can compute its exact monthly cost before applying.
strings.t: **Pri ki byen pibliye, ki fasil pou li** — chak sesyon gen yon tarif 5-day, 3-day ak drop-in nan handbook la, kidonk yon fanmi ka kalkile kòb egzak li chak mwa anvan li aplike.

strings.text: **A structured, literature-based kindergarten afternoon** — Young Cougars Club runs story, art and activities rotations on weekly themes, not undifferentiated supervision.
strings.t: **Yon apremidi matènèl estriktire, ki baze sou literati** — Young Cougars Club mache wotasyon istwa, atizay ak aktivite sou tèm chak semèn, se pa yon senp siveyans san diferans.

strings.text: **A flat drop-in rate exists** — $30/day for YCC and After School — so occasional-need families are not forced into a full contract.
strings.t: **Gen yon tarif fiks drop-in** — $30/day pou YCC ak After School — kidonk fanmi ki gen bezwen okazyonèl pa fòse antre nan yon kontra konplè.

strings.text: **Homework space for grades 1–8**, with a separate area for Middle School students who arrive by 3:30.
strings.t: **Espas pou devwa pou klas 1–8**, ak yon zòn apa pou elèv Middle School ki rive anvan 3:30.

strings.text: **A mission-driven, explicitly Christian framing** — the “Grow and Go” mission runs through the whole program.
strings.t: **Yon fòm eksplisitman kretyen, ki mennen pa misyon an** — misyon “Grow and Go” la travèse tout pwogram nan.

strings.text: **The 2026-2027 year is already listed as full.** A family applying now may face a waitlist rather than open enrollment.
strings.t: **Ane 2026-2027 la deja make kòm full.** Yon fanmi ki aplike kounye a ka jwenn yon lis datant olye yon enskripsyon louvri.

strings.text: **The enrichment and music-lesson list is not published** for 2026-27 — promised “August 2026,” so families cannot yet see what classes or instruments are offered, on what days, or at what cost.
strings.t: **Lis anrichisman ak leson mizik la pa pibliye** pou 2026-27 — pwomèt “August 2026,” kidonk fanmi yo poko ka wè ki klas oswa enstriman yo ofri, ki jou, oswa a ki pri.

strings.text: **No registration fee or sibling discount is published**, so the true cost for a multi-child family cannot be computed from the handbook alone.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn frè enskripsyon ni rabè frè/sè ki pibliye**, kidonk vrè kòb la pou yon fanmi ki gen plizyè timoun pa ka kalkile ak handbook la sèlman.

strings.text: **No annual dollar total is stated** — only monthly rates billed over 9 months, so the year figure must be derived.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn total anyèl an dola ki deklare** — sèlman tarif chak mwa faktire sou 9 mwa, kidonk chif ane a dwe kalkile.

strings.text: **Only 5-day and 3-day contracts are offered**, with no 2- or 4-day rate; anything in between goes through the flat drop-in rate.
strings.t: **Se sèlman kontra 5-day ak 3-day ki ofri**, san okenn tarif 2- oswa 4-day; tout sa ki nan mitan pase nan tarif fiks drop-in an.

strings.text: **No staff-to-child ratio is published** for either YCC or After School care.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn rapò anplwaye-ak-timoun ki pibliye** pou ni YCC ni After School care.

strings.text: No staff-to-child ratio, group size, or hour-by-hour schedule is published beyond the activity lists above; the enrichment activities are named but not run as a filterable class catalog with days, grades or fees.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn rapò estaf-a-timoun, gwosè gwoup, oswa orè èdtan pa èdtan ki pibliye pi lwen pase lis aktivite anwo yo; aktivite anrichisman yo gen non men yo pa prezante kòm yon katalòg klas ou ka filtre ak jou, nivo oswa frè.

strings.text: A single, age-split afternoon program that covers the whole school to 5:30 p.m. — with fully published activities but no published price, and no summer coverage.
strings.t: Yon sèl pwogram aprèmidi ki separe pa laj epi ki kouvri tout lekòl la jiska 5:30 p.m. — ak aktivite ki byen pibliye men san okenn pri ki pibliye, epi san kouvèti pou ete.

strings.text: The open questions are the unpublished recurring rate, the missing staff ratio, and the fact that both tracks are full-year commitments with no drop-in option.
strings.t: Kesyon ki rete yo se to regilye ki pa pibliye a, rapò estaf ki manke a, ak fè ke tou de pis yo se angajman pou tout ane a san okenn opsyon san randevou.

strings.text: **Whole-school coverage in one window** — TK–5 Afterschool and 6–11 Study Hall both run 2:30–5:30 p.m., so there is no division gap.
strings.t: **Kouvèti pou tout lekòl la nan yon sèl fenèt** — Afterschool TK–5 ak Study Hall 6–11 tou de fonksyone 2:30–5:30 p.m., kidonk pa gen okenn twou ant divizyon yo.

strings.text: **A clearly described afternoon** — the TK–5 activity list (homework help, outdoor play, reading, computer lab) and the 6–11 Study Hall framing are published in the school's own words.
strings.t: **Yon aprèmidi ki byen dekri** — lis aktivite TK–5 la (èd devwa, jwèt deyò, lekti, laboratwa enfòmatik) ak chapant Study Hall 6–11 la pibliye nan pwòp mo lekòl la.

strings.text: **An older-grade study track** — Study Hall for grades 6–11 is a genuine supervised-homework option, not just younger-child care.
strings.t: **Yon pis etid pou gwo nivo yo** — Study Hall pou grad 6–11 se yon vrè opsyon devwa ak sipèvizyon, se pa senpleman gadri pou timoun piti.

strings.text: **A named director** — Belinda Jackson, with a direct phone line, runs the program.
strings.t: **Yon direktè ki gen non** — Belinda Jackson, ak yon liy telefòn dirèk, ap dirije pwogram nan.

strings.text: **The recurring price is not published** — neither the Afterschool page nor the Tuition and Fees page states a monthly or annual rate; families must go through the student-services fee documents or FACTS portal.
strings.t: **Pri regilye a pa pibliye** — ni paj Afterschool la ni paj Tuition and Fees la pa bay yon to mansyèl oswa anyèl; fanmi yo dwe pase nan dokiman frè student-services yo oswa pòtal FACTS la.

strings.text: **No single-day drop-ins** — both tracks are full-year commitments billed annually, so occasional-need families have no flexible option (the only drop-in is the separate $35/day out-of-session Adventure Days).
strings.t: **Pa gen san randevou pou yon sèl jou** — tou de pis yo se angajman pou tout ane a faktire chak ane, kidonk fanmi ki gen bezwen detanzantan pa gen okenn opsyon fleksib (sèl opsyon san randevou a se Adventure Days apa a nan $35/jou deyò sesyon an).

strings.text: **No summer coverage** — the program is closed during the summer; there is no summer wrap-around care, and summer camps are half-day only.
strings.t: **Pa gen kouvèti pou ete** — pwogram nan fèmen pandan ete a; pa gen okenn gadri pwolonje pou ete, epi kan ete yo se demi-jounen sèlman.

strings.text: **No staff-to-child ratio** is published for either track.
strings.t: **Pa gen okenn rapò estaf-a-timoun** ki pibliye ni pou yon pis ni pou lòt la.

strings.text: What does the recurring Afterschool program actually cost per year for TK–5, and what payment plans are offered?
strings.t: Konbyen pwogram Afterschool regilye a koute vre pa ane pou TK–5, epi ki plan pèman yo ofri?

strings.text: Is the Study Hall for grades 6–11 the same price as the TK–5 Afterschool program, or billed separately?
strings.t: Èske Study Hall pou grad 6–11 la gen menm pri ak pwogram Afterschool TK–5 la, oswa èske yo faktire l apa?

strings.text: What is the staff-to-child ratio in Afterschool and in Study Hall?
strings.t: Ki rapò estaf-a-timoun nan nan Afterschool ak nan Study Hall?

strings.text: Since there are no drop-ins, is there any way to enroll for only some afternoons a week?
strings.t: Piske pa gen opsyon san randevou, èske gen yon fason pou enskri pou kèk aprèmidi sèlman pa semèn?

strings.text: What are the "student services fees" that hold the after-school rate, and where can we see them before enrolling?
strings.t: Ki sa "student services fees" yo ye ki kenbe to aprè-lekòl la, epi kote nou ka wè yo anvan nou enskri?

strings.text: What child-care options exist in the summer, given the program is closed — beyond the half-day camps?
strings.t: Ki opsyon gadri ki egziste nan ete a, piske pwogram nan fèmen — pi lwen pase kan demi-jounen yo?
